name: Apply

methods.name: automaticHandling
methods.documentation: Overrides whether this apply participates in automatic model command handling.

methods.name: conflictPolicy
methods.documentation: Overrides conflict handling for the model produced by this apply.

methods.name: disableCompatibilityCheck
methods.documentation:
Disables apply-compatibility checking for this method.

Unless property {@code fluxzero.assert.legal.apply-compatibility} is explicitly set to {@code false}, Fluxzero verifies that at least one {@code @Apply} method is compatible with the current entity state.

Setting this flag to {@code true} exempts this method from that check.

methods.name: eventPublication
methods.documentation:
Controls whether the update should result in a published update, depending on whether the entity was actually modified.

This overrides the default from the enclosing aggregate, if set. @return update publication behavior

methods.name: eventRouting
methods.documentation:
Controls how an update event published by this apply method is assigned to a message segment.

This setting applies to aggregates and defaults to the enclosing aggregate configuration. Events produced by independent {@link Model Models} use ordinary message routing; annotate their payload with {@link io.fluxzero.sdk.publishing.routing.RoutingKey @RoutingKey} when related events should share a segment. @return routing behavior for the applied update event

methods.name: graphProjectionCompletion
methods.documentation: Overrides command-result completion for graph projections affected by this apply.

methods.name: publicationStrategy
methods.documentation:
Controls how the applied update is stored and/or published, and whether publish-only updates advance aggregate
 state for the owning aggregate type. This strategy takes precedence over {@link #eventPublication()} if explicitly
 set. A publish-only apply cannot change an event-sourced {@link Model}; Fluxzero rejects such a transition before
 commit because its stored stream could not reconstruct the new state. Publish-only no-ops and changes to
 document-loaded models remain supported.

 @return strategy for persisting and/or publishing the applied update
